text: Whoa...I-if it's like this, no matter how we try\nwe won't be able to go to the Weredragons' Vital\nPoint...
You used the Weredragon's Handprint you received\nfrom Leader Atu!
I knew they were after the Weredragons' Vital\nPoint!!
You guys just go to the Weredragons' Vital Point!
Remember what Uncle Boontam said...? He said it's\nhighly likely that the power from the vital point\nbecame unstable because of Coenubias' invasion.
If that's true, don't you think you guys need to\nget there to get rid of those troublemakers\nas soon as possible?!
Muti and I will take care of the monsters here,\nyou guys should go!
I mean just look at their wobbly legs, I'm sure\nthe monsters will soon catch up to us if we leave\nand let them handle those monsters alone.
Sorry, but I'll stay here to help them.\nYou go first, I'm counting on you!
